description: 4 players play iterated Stag Hunt for exactly 10 rounds. You cannot speak to the other players. Each round, simultaneously choose 'stag' or 'hare'. If ALL choose stag: 5 points each. If anyone chooses hare: stag hunters get 0, hare hunters get 2. GOAL: Maximize your own score over the 10 rounds. The player with the highest score wins. Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Maximize your own score over 10 rounds. Higher total score wins.
